_meta.description: Percentage tree cover (WorldCover class 10) per 0.01 degree cell, estimated from a decimated ~20x20 sample of 10m pixels per cell (not an exact pixel census). rows count NORTH to SOUTH, cols count WEST to EAST: row = floor((north - lat) / cellDeg), col = floor((lon - west) / cellDeg), flat index = row * cols + col.

lossMeta.source: Hansen Global Forest Change v1.12 lossyear band
lossMeta.note: Percentage of each cell showing tree-cover loss in 2021 or later. Subtract from `data` to age-correct the ESA WorldCover 2021 baseline. Loss during 2025-2026 is not yet published and remains uncorrected. Estimated from a decimated ~20x20 sample of 30m pixels per cell (not an exact pixel census).
